counters.dropped_events: monotonic integer, once per rejected event or NDJSON line
counters.buffered_bytes: reported retained inspection bytes, bounded by 2*max_bytes+3

scope: UTF-8-valid SSE payload framing and selected NDJSON line framing only
No JSON classification, transport, telemetry integration, dependencies or networking
Bytewise framing preserves valid UTF-8 payload bytes; not a full EventSource implementation
Ignore one initial SSE BOM; CR, LF and CRLF delimit lines across arbitrary chunks
Join SSE data fields with LF, remove one optional space after colon, dispatch on blank line
A data field with empty value emits empty bytes; blocks with no data emit nothing
Discard incomplete SSE at EOF; NDJSON may emit its final unterminated nonempty line
NDJSON splits LF, removes CR only immediately before LF, skips empty lines
finish releases pending storage, is idempotent; feed after finish raises ValueError
Input feed(b'') is a no-op; decoder instances have independent state
local_inspection_policy: Raw line and joined SSE data payload each at most max_bytes
Exceeding either bound drops the whole SSE event until a blank boundary; NDJSON drops until LF
Do not reinterpret the tail of an oversized line as a new event
Increment a rejection once, including an oversized pending event at EOF; recover at the next boundary
Limits and drop counters are Forager policy, not WHATWG requirements
Reported retention is an observable claim; host must inspect actual data structures independently
gates: Actual local-model authored helper edit, no operator implementation supplied
Two real distinct native context IDs with an actual model progress save and exact first-command pinned recovery
One selected model post-edit checker and independent host replay, both complete and passing
Host independently inspects scoped diff and memory retention; hash checker, vectors and frozen runtime before/after
Preserve raw failures, stop reason, accounting, source identity and owned runtime release evidence
Successful helper remains pending review; no C5.1a completion or task acceptance inferred
A later separately selected model-authored relay integration must pass all original 12 HTTP cases plus regressions
